NitimalaPage.title: Policy (Policy Manual)
NitimalaPage.approver: Approving Body: Interim Executive Committee (Interim EC)
NitimalaPage.legalRef: Legal References: Applicable laws and regulations (Bangladesh relevant Acts and amendments, related rules/circulars).
NitimalaPage.disclaimer: Disclaimer: This is a general draft policy for a start-up initiative. Legal review by a lawyer is mandatory before finalization.
NitimalaPage.intro: This policy document defines a professional framework for governance, financial transparency, risk control, and member service excellence. Below are the table of contents and detailed sections.

purpose.purposeText: To define integrated rules for governance, financial management, programs, brand, information management, transparency, and risk control.
purpose.scopeText: All members, elected representatives, staff, volunteers, consultants, partners, vendors, and visitors (where applicable).
purpose.definition1: Member: An approved applicant whose membership is active.
purpose.definition2: Share/Contribution: Money/equity provided according to constitution and policies.
purpose.definition3: Community Capital Pool (CCP): A fund of members' collective capital, spent for approved purposes.
purpose.definition4: Pilot: Small-scale experimental activity; collect learnings to scale up.

governance.structure2: Executive Committee (EC) — President, Vice President, General Secretary, Treasurer, Members
governance.meetings1: AGM: At least once a year; Quorum: [1/3] of total members or [as per constitution]
governance.meetings3: Minutes summary to be uploaded on website within 7 working days.
governance.election1: EC Tenure: [2] years; Maximum [2] consecutive terms
governance.election2: Election Method: As per constitution/election rules, independent returning officer.
governance.coi1: COI declaration form mandatory; abstain from vote/decision
governance.coi2: If transacting with relatives/own entities, inform EC in writing in advance.
governance.amendText: EC proposal → Member consultation → Approval in AGM/special meeting; maintain version control.

membership.eligibilityText: 18+, [Upazila/Union] resident/entrepreneur, compliance with constitution/policies, NID/address proof.
membership.processText: Pre-registration → Verification → Orientation → Approval → Member ID.
membership.feesText: Admission Fee: [৳X], Share Contribution: [৳Y]/unit; Annual Renewal: [৳Z]. (Final after approval)
membership.rightsText: Voting rights (where applicable), right to information, compliance with policies, regularization of dues/contributions.
membership.suspensionText: In case of non-payment, misconduct, COI violation—Show-cause → Hearing → Decision.

finance.banking1: Named bank account; Joint signatory: Treasurer + President/General Secretary.
finance.banking2: Double-entry accounting, monthly close, annual audit.
finance.budget1: Annual budget approved at AGM; quarterly review.
finance.budget2: Extra-budgetary expense > [৳50,000] requires special EC approval.
finance.grantsText: Accept after legal setup is complete; until then, collect pledge forms—no money acceptance.
finance.transparencyText: Quarterly expense summary, annual financial statements, independent audit summary on website.

ccp.purposeText: Support for micro-entrepreneurs/equipment/raw materials/working capital; not a bank—limited and risk-controlled support under community initiative structure.
ccp.sourceText: Member contributions, approved donations/CSR (if legally permitted), part of surplus.
ccp.eligibility2: Exposure per member: ≤ [৳X] or [Y%] of CCP, whichever is less
ccp.eligibility3: Portfolio cap: ≤ [30%] in a single sector
ccp.approvalText: Application → Pre-screen → Credit/Risk Sub-committee → EC resolution.
ccp.disbursementText: Installment/milestone-based; priority to pay directly to vendor/supplier.
ccp.monitoringText: Monthly visit/report; if issues identified, reschedule/support.
ccp.defaultText: 30+ days overdue = special monitoring; 90+ days = non-performing; provisioning rate [X%]; recovery to be fair and humane.

procurement.principlesText: Value-for-money, quality, timeliness, fair competition, COI control.
procurement.vendorText: Quality with price, delivery record, warranty/support, locality/equity considerations.
procurement.docsText: Purchase requisition → Approval → PO/Contract → GRN/Invoice → Payment voucher.
procurement.emergencyText: In case of life/property risk, fast-track procurement with EC minimum quorum approval; regularize within 7 days.

brand.ownershipText: Registered trademarks/brands of the initiative are owned by the initiative; for member/partner usage, license agreements apply.
brand.qualityText: Quality, traceability, labelling/barcode/batching policies for brand usage.
brand.commsText: Only designated spokespersons will issue media statements; social media guidelines must be followed.
brand.contentRightsText: Written consent for use of photos/videos; additional safeguards for children/vulnerable persons.

privacy.collectText: Minimum necessary data for membership/pilots/events; purpose limitation.
privacy.storeText: Password-protected drives, access control, encrypted backups.
privacy.useText: No sale to third parties without law/consent/contract; anonymized data may be used for research.
privacy.retentionText: Member records [7] years, financial records [10] years, media consents [5] years; secure destruction after expiry.
privacy.incidentText: Report data breach to EC within 72 hours; notify as necessary.

safeguarding.childText: Safe environment, guidelines, background checks (where applicable), reporting channels.
safeguarding.harassmentText: Zero tolerance; receive complaints confidentially, conduct impartial investigations.
safeguarding.inclusionText: Equal opportunity regardless of gender, religion, ethnicity; accessible design for persons with disabilities.
safeguarding.codeText: Anti-bribery/corruption/gifts policy, conflict of interest, respectful language, non-discrimination.

grievance.slaText: Acknowledgment within 7 days, initial review within 14 days, resolution target 30–45 days.
grievance.confidentialityText: Identity of informant protected; retaliation prohibited.
grievance.appealText: If complainant is not satisfied, appeal to EC/Advisory Board.

others.p11Text: Course design: local needs-based, minimum 20–30 hour modules, pre- and post-assessments. Selection: priority—women/youth/low-income members; transparent criteria.
others.p12Text: Environment: waste management, plastic reduction, energy saving, water management. Workplace safety: PPE, fire safety, first aid, incident log.
others.p13Text: Baseline: member profile, income, skills—collected before launch/start. KPI (Year-1): number of policy approvals, number/completion rate of pilots, partner MOUs, feedback sessions.
others.p14Text: Registration status, policies, budget summary, EC minutes summary, audit summary—regularly updated on the website.
others.p15Text: Process: EOI → Due diligence → Define purpose/roles → MOU → Pilot → Evaluation.
others.p16Text: Spokespersons: President/General Secretary/Designated media lead. Social media: official handles; use 'own views' disclaimer for personal opinions.
others.p17Text: Constitution/policies: permanent; AGM/EC minutes: permanent; financial receipts/invoices: 10 years; member register: 7 years; procurement docs: 7 years.
others.p18Text: Register: list of strategic/operational/financial/reputational risks; probability × impact score. Treatment: avoid, reduce, share, accept.
others.p19Text: Stepwise: verbal warning → written warning → temporary suspension → permanent cancellation (AGM approval if necessary). Clear appeal process.
others.p20Text: Effectiveness: effective from approval date. Exceptions: case-to-case with EC written decision; document reasons and duration. Amendments: annual review; interim changes if necessary.

annexes.left3: Annex-C: Procurement thresholds and RFQ/RFP templates
annexes.left4: Annex-D: CCP application form and evaluation checklist
annexes.left5: Annex-E: Grievance form and process flow
